The solutions' reasoning doesn't hold up on inspection, and I can't verify the correct count from memory. Solution 2's claim that odd and even chains split into independent families with no cross-embeddings contradicts the standard structure of Sugihara chains. Solution 3's claim that the lattice is isomorphic to $(\omega+1)^2$ is unjustified. Solution 1 gives no checkable argument for its count of eight. I don't have a reliable reference value for the answer, so I can't confirm any of the three numbers.

CHOICE: NONE
CONFIDENCE: 2
